notes.title: Update 1.1 is live!
notes.content:
[p]This long-awaited update brings important improvements to race generation modes. The new Live Timing mode, based on a text-and-table layout, combines fast race simulation with strategic control over driver pit strategy. The simplified interface also made it possible to implement multi-car collisions and safety car deployments.
[/p][p]The tyre performance model has been reworked. It now behaves non-linearly—tyres maintain their effectiveness longer and only noticeably drop off closer to the end of their lifespan. This allows for strong lap times over longer stints.
[/p][p]Version 1.1 changelog:[/p][list][*][p]New Live Timing mode[/p][/*][*][p]Improved tyre performance model for both Live Timing and 3D modes[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked weather changes in Live Timing and 3D[/p][/*][*][p]Driver and staff skills now range from 1 to 20[/p][/*][*][p]Board confidence penalty for missed targets halved[/p][/*][*][p]Qualifying duel information moved from the News section to the Championship section[/p][/*][*][p]Various bug fixes across the game and mod integration[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]During development, several cases of game freezes during the off-season were also addressed. If you have an older save affected by this issue, please check whether it now loads correctly after installing version 1.1. If the problem persists, you can send the save file to [url="https://admin@paprikashgames.com"]admin@paprikashgames.com[/url] or via Discord.[/p][p][/p][p]The editor has also been updated to the latest version: h[url="https://paprikashgames.com/OWM2EditorBuild.zip"]ttps://paprikashgames.com/OWM2EditorBuild.zip[/url]

We fixed a number of bugs and added support for loading driver statistics from [url="https://gpracingstats.com"]gpracingstats.com[/url]
The external stats block is displayed in-game separately from internal stats and does not affect them in any way. To maintain compatibility with older mods, driver and staff parameters are still entered in the editor using a 1–10 scale and are automatically converted to a 1–20 scale in-game.[/p]

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2
notes.content:
* fixed a bug where a driver who decided to retire could sign a new contract

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.content:
* Fixed problems with signing drivers to the main team from the youth academy. Sometimes drivers signed up for the wrong driver role
* Fixed freezes in the offseason caused by incorrect signing of a contract in the main team between the AI team and a young driver if the contract led to a reduction in the term of the current contract of main driver. 
* Fixed the freezing of the driver contract negotiation screen if a team salary limit is set to 0$ for his driver role
*  Fixed an issue where the driver can't be fired even with the approval from board
* Fixed a bug where a player could assign young drivers to a team in excess of the allowed number of drivers per team in their championship. This led to off-season freezes. When loading a save, some erroneous contracts may be terminated. We recommend checking the distribution of your young academy drivers, even if you did it earlier this season

notes.title: Private and Factory Team Update (beta)
notes.content:
This update focuses on dividing teams into private and factory ones, as such, instead of purely having a manager who is also the owner of the team, you can now have managers who are appointed by a team.

[b]Warning: [/b][i]Since the update is still going through testing, we recommend that you make a backup of your save before continuing playing. This can be done by loading a previous save and saving it under a new name once it has loaded.[/i]

[b]Release notes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Added manager skills
[*] The manager has an age, and managers can now retire.
[*] The manager has a personal balance, which will separate his finances from the team's balance
[*] You are now able to not only sell shares in your team, but you can also buy shares of other teams if they are put up for sale due to the team's financial situation.
[*] You can either sell your team to an investor (with a name change or without a change - according to the investor's decision), or buy an entire team in financial crisis (in this case, you will become the manager of the purchased team) - Note once you can only manage the team you have the highest controlling stake in. 
[*] Private and factory teams now have slightly different left menu items. For example, when managing a factory team, bank loans are not available to you, and when managing a private team, salary limits are removed.
[*] Factory team board now have defined performance targets for each season to the manager. If they are not fulfilled, the trust of the team's board will decrease.
[*] When managing a factory team, you will need the consent of the team's board for some actions. For example, for the construction of infrastructure or the firing a driver.
[*] Authority points have been removed from the game due to loss of relevance.
[*] Drivers and staff now have a motivation skill. You can influence this by using the Motivation manager skill.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43761480/13c14624427b3099c7bd2d1ceb1bc4d9b7ae2ab9.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43761480/cf8481fb1e6232deb52156822fa0f48d8d32d94f.png[/img] [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43761480/26b7b74b319ecfd50ef64dfd58f93d295db1f651.png[/img]

[b]Balance Adjustments and Detail
[/b]
[list]
[*] Car setup has become more influential on the car performance in race weekend
[*] Reserve drivers can now participate only in practice sessions
[*] The team's income and expenses screen has become more detailed 
[*]  The salary demands of drivers have been reduced to avoid the constant withdrawal of successful drivers from the championship. If you are in the middle of a season, you will not notice this change until the next season.
[/list]

notes.title: HOTFIX #8
notes.content:
* The signing bonus for the driver and staff, as well as other bonuses for the driver, are now also subject to the salary cap. If you increase the salary limit, for example, by 10%, then the limits on bonuses will increase by 10%

* The choice between repair and upgrade for AI teams has been optimized. This should reduce (but not eliminate) the number of retires due to parts failure for teams that have all the car parts of level 8-10 and a production facility of level 3 or lower (this fix for mods, no one teams like this in default databse)

notes.title: Game Editor beta-test
notes.content:
We have completed work on the first iteration of the game editor and invite you to explore its capabilities
You can download the editor from the link https://paprikashgames.com/OWM2EditorBuild.zip

Things to remember:
* The mod.io system has not yet been integrated into the data editor, so the editor works with mod files locally. To check a mod in the game, just move it to the Mods folder (you will need to create a folder) in the root of the game and start a new game
* To create a mod based on a standard database, you will need to specify the path to the database file. It is located in the root of the game (not the editor) in the Database folder.
* Remember that this is a beta test. When creating a mod, save often.
* If bugs occur in the editor or in the game, post report to discord please
* The editor does not yet have all the functions that we would like to add, so stay tuned to the discord so as not to miss new versions

In our discord we have created a mods channel where you can share your mods. When mod.io will be  integrated, you can upload this mods to the server

notes.title: Polish translation and dev update
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

The season in real-life F1 has just started, so it's time to talk about the latest news related to development.
Firstly, we would like to thank the efforts of Discord user FortiCorse for adding Polish localization to the game. This is another example of how we have the most amazing community!

Secondly, there is a 15% discount on the game until March 7th.

Finally, let's discuss the current state of development for OWM2. The editor is nearly ready. Thanks to the hard work of our beta tester, Meanie, the first mod has been created and we are already testing it in-game. 

Our primary goal is to ensure that the mod does not cause crashes or other errors that arise after several seasons of play. After testing has been completed, we will release the editor for free on our Discord server for everyone to access. In the meantime, as you explore its capabilities, we will continue integrating the platform for mods, so you can subscribe to and download mods similar to the Steam Workshop. For now, the game only reads mods from the "Mods" folder, where mod files must be manually transferred. 

The live-timing for viewing race is also nearing beta testing. Currently, the functionality is almost at the same level as live timing in 3D mode.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43761480/bc7c74e96588879ecd5a00ac0bf0509b422b099a.gif[/img]

And finally, updating the departments. In fact, this is not only about departments because buildings and departments are involved in car development and repair, as well as negotiations with suppliers and staff. That is, almost all of the office screens will change. The work is still far from being complete here. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43761480/7a85059bdab5a07f5dd79f0315a9454ce1bed04c.gif[/img]

notes.title: HOTFIX #7 + UPDATE + FAN TRANSLATIONS (FR, IT)
notes.content:
[b]Fixes and balance changes:[/b]
* Slightly reduced the chances of getting level -3, -2, +2, +3 from the chief designer level when creating a new chassis
* Fixed a bug where in some cases the AI ​​did not repair the engine when the balance was negative, even if the engine was free
* The cost of maintaining buildings has been reduced by almost three times. The incorrect value of the cost led to the gradual bankruptcy of the Kinowaki team, which has the maximum level of buildings.
* Fixed a bug where the sale of shares could lead to a decrease in the salary limit for drivers and staff
* On the sponsor search screen you can now add a sponsorship sticker by clicking on the letter in the right panel

notes.title: HOTFIX #6
notes.content:
* Fixed a bug where it was impossible to sign two drivers with "equal driver" role
* Fixed incorrect display of the driver's retire date
* Fixed gained points on the test track. Previously, in some cases, fewer points could be awarded than displayed.
* Fixed an important bug when AI teams could not replace the engine in some cases
* Fixed a bug when AI teams in a financial crisis did not sell all shares.

notes.title: HOTFIX #5
notes.content:
* Fixed rare freeze when the AI ​​could start two task in a wind tunnel in the same week
* Fixed wrong behavior of the efficiency graph on the car repair and upgrade screen
* Fixed a rare bug that caused the game to freeze at the first race of the season
* Prize money has been increased x1.5. The initial prizes was set before the implementation functionality of a strong drop in the condition of car parts during accidents/tech problems. Which led to some overspending money on repairs
* Added news about the size of the salary limits. The news will come in the first week of each season

notes.title: HOTFIX #4
notes.content:
* Fixed a bug where it was possible to make an offer to an engine supplier for a sponsorship contract even when the supplier had no free slots left
* Fixed a bug when the team profile did not load after the team was acquisition by a engine supplier
* Fixed the behavior of the +/- buttons when selecting a pit stop lap in the strategy panel during the race. Previously, pressing + and - would immediately change the lap, which could lead to an instant pit stop (when the value matched the current lap). Now the new value is set a second after you stop pressing + or -
* Fixed a bug in the drivers search when selecting the filters “desired role: reserve driver” and “driver with sponsorship” a list of drivers was displayed, none of whom met both criteria

notes.title: HOTFIX #3 + Small update
notes.content:
* Fixed several freezes related to the dismissal of drivers (thx for bugreports in Discord)
* Fixed an wrong news report that an engine supplier was willing to sign a contract when in fact the offer was declined

+ Track parameters added to the calendar screen

notes.title: HOTFIX #2
notes.content:
* Fixed a bug where after 10+ seasons all tyres parameters up to maximum
* Skill growth of key staff (chief designer, production, marketing) in the off-season has been significantly increased. Previously, growth was too low and over time, retiring staff were replaced by new ones with 1-1 skills and did not grow further.
* AI in the rain has become more conservative and does not put rain tyres too early
* Fixed a bug when in-race save after loading going to error
* Fixed a bug where UI language was set to Russian by default
* Chance to firing regular staff in building has been significantly reduced. Previously, the number of hired and fired staff was approximately the same and it was hard to fill the building with staff

notes.title: HOTFIX #1
notes.content:
* Fixed a bug when solving two or more chassis problems in one week, only one was performed
* Fixed rare freeze in week generation
